local self=require('openmw.self')
local core=require('openmw.core')
local util=require('openmw.util')
local camera=require('openmw.camera')
local Actor=require('openmw.types').Actor
local nearby=require('openmw.nearby')
local input=require('openmw.input')
local frame=0
local sampleFrame=nil
local held=false
local function aim(p)
 local t=camera.getViewTransform():inverse()
 local origin=t:apply(util.vector3(0,0,0))
 local f=t:apply(util.vector3(0,0,-1))-origin
 local d=p-origin
 local yaw=math.atan2(f.y*d.x-f.x*d.y,f.x*d.x+f.y*d.y)
 local pitch=math.atan2(f.z,math.sqrt(f.x*f.x+f.y*f.y))-math.atan2(d.z,math.sqrt(d.x*d.x+d.y*d.y))
 local gain=camera.getMode()==camera.MODE.FirstPerson and 1 or 2
 local function units(a) return math.max(-8192,math.min(8192,math.floor(a*5120+.5))) end
 return units(yaw*gain),units(pitch),math.abs(yaw)<.04 and math.abs(pitch)<.04
end
local points={{util.vector3(-299.9357604980469,3430.19091796875,-264.0),util.vector3(-329.5753173828125,3592.852294921875,-248.0),util.vector3(-458.577880859375,3824.40234375,-258.0),util.vector3(-492.0541076660156,4163.08740234375,-258.0),util.vector3(-619.494873046875,4200.21728515625,-230.0)}}
local step=1
local movingTime=0
local wasMoving=false
local locked=nil
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 frame=frame+1
 local down=input.isKeyPressed(input.KEY.F7)
 if down and not held then sampleFrame=frame+3 end
 if not down then sampleFrame=nil end
 held=down
 if sampleFrame and frame>=sampleFrame then print('Substructure camera settled') end
 assert(not Actor.isDead(self),'Player died on joined corridor')
 if frame==5 then
  local armor=0 local axe=false
  for _,item in pairs(Actor.getEquipment(self)) do
   if item.recordId==core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x661c1) or item.recordId==core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x661c3) then armor=armor+1 end
   if item.recordId==core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x90613) then axe=true end
  end
  assert(armor==2 and axe,'Joined chest gear missing') print('Joined corridor ready')
 end
 local target,distance=nil,nil
 for _,id in ipairs({{0x38171,0x38172}}) do
  local rat=nearby.getObjectByFormId(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',id))
  assert(rat and rat:isValid(),'Original west-approach rat missing')
  if rat.enabled and not Actor.isDead(rat) and rat.cell and rat.cell.id==self.cell.id then
   local dist=(rat.position-self.position):length()
   if not distance or dist<distance then target,distance=rat,dist end
  end
 end
 if locked and locked:isValid() and locked.enabled and not Actor.isDead(locked)
  and locked.cell and locked.cell.id==self.cell.id
  and (locked.position-self.position):length()<=180 then
  target=locked distance=(locked.position-self.position):length()
 else locked=target end
 local nearThreat=target and distance<=350
 if step<=#points then
  local p=points[step]
  local delta=p-self.position
  if math.sqrt(delta.x*delta.x+delta.y*delta.y)<55 and not nearThreat then
   print('Joined corridor waypoint '..step..' reached '..tostring(self.position)) step=step+1
  end
 end
 local cleared=step>#points and not nearThreat
 if cleared then
  print('Joined west approach cleared')
  print('Joined west course aim x=0 y=0')
  print('Joined west course facing')
 else
  local approach
  if nearThreat then approach=target.position+util.vector3(0,0,100)
  elseif step<=#points then approach=util.vector3(points[step].x,points[step].y,self.position.z+100)
  else approach=target.position+util.vector3(0,0,100) end
  local x,y,facing=aim(approach)
  print(string.format('Joined west course aim x=%d y=%d',x,y))
  if facing then print('Joined west course facing') end
 end
 if nearThreat then print('Joined west nearby threat '..tostring(target.recordId)..' distance='..distance) end
 local moving=self.controls.movement>0
 if moving then
  if not wasMoving then movingTime=0 end
  movingTime=movingTime+dt
  if movingTime>=.25 or (target and distance<=150) or cleared then print('Joined west movement segment stop') end
 end
 wasMoving=moving
 if frame%15==0 then
  print('Joined corridor Player '..tostring(self.position)..' health='..Actor.stats.dynamic.health(self).current)
  for _,id in ipairs({{0x38172,0x38171,0x38175,0x38176,0x38818}}) do
   local obj=nearby.getObjectByFormId(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',id))
   if obj and obj:isValid() then print('Joined room actor '..id..' pos='..tostring(obj.position)..' dead='..tostring(Actor.isDead(obj))..' health='..Actor.stats.dynamic.health(obj).current) end
  end
 end
end}}}}
